story:
Title: AURA NOIR

Hook:
A monolithic obsidian glass perfume bottle floats in zero-gravity, enveloped in liquid rose-gold chrome and pressurized violet mist.

Scene 1:
A monolithic obsidian black glass perfume bottle floats suspended in anti-gravity, adorned with glistening amber condensation beads under sharp golden studio rim-lighting.
Action: Extreme macro slow push-in as light glints across the polished obsidian glass facet and glistening condensation micro-droplets.

Scene 2:
Molten liquid rose-gold mercury swirls dynamically around the obsidian glass flacon in zero-gravity.
Action: Viscous metallic chrome fluid flows gracefully around the black bottle curves with smooth fluid dynamics and radiant reflections.

Scene 3:
A high-velocity pressurized mist plume bursts from the chrome atomizer nozzle in ultra slow-motion.
Action: Microscopic fragrance vapor explodes outward into the air, backlit by intense anamorphic violet laser lighting.

Scene 4:
A heavy diamond-cut magnetic cap snaps down onto the obsidian glass bottle neck with authoritative mechanical precision.
Action: The magnetic cap locks into place with a crisp snap, revealing the glowing minimalist gold typography AURA NOIR.

Tagline:
Aura Noir. Beyond matter.

director_notes.visual_style: Ultra-luxury dark cyberpunk commercial aesthetic rendered with pristine high-contrast macro clarity. Dominant deep obsidian blacks paired with molten metallic rose-gold and electric violet reflections, featuring subtle anamorphic highlight halation and polished glass refractive textures with velvety deep shadows.
director_notes.camera_style: Slow deliberate micro-movements locked to a 9:16 vertical center-safe composition using 85mm and 100mm macro prime lenses. Strictly limited to linear micro push-ins, subtle vertical tilts, and slow rotational orbits with zero handheld shake, fast pans, or erratic zooms.
director_notes.lighting: High-fashion dark field commercial studio illumination featuring sharp 3200K amber/rose-gold rim lighting, 6500K anamorphic violet laser edge-lighting, and high-contrast specular reflections cutting through delicate volumetric aerosol mist.
director_notes.editing: Hypnotic commercial pacing with exact 5.0-second scene durations, cutting precisely on mechanical action cues with ultra-slow-motion ramped physics and seamless match-on-action transitions.
director_notes.music: 85 BPM, enigmatic and opulent mood, deep analog sub-bass with tactile crystalline synth plucks, dense granular atmospheric textures, dynamic sub-drop build releasing into a sharp mechanical impact.
director_notes.style_lock: Ultra-luxury cyberpunk commercial, obsidian black and molten rose-gold palette with 3200K warm amber and violet accents, precision studio rim-lighting with backlit volumetric vapor, 100mm macro anamorphic lens with specular halation, photorealistic 8k tactile material physics.
avoid: warping geometry or morphing bottle contours
cartoonish or hyper-saturated flat neon lighting
unwanted human hands or figures in frame
harsh blown-out specular highlights with digital noise
unmotivated camera shake and unstable focal breathing
text overlays or watermarks inside generation area
fast chaotic motion or erratic camera whipping
sudden jarring background pop-in or color flickering
